Plot a contour map model

Source: R/contour_mds.R
plot.mdspace_contour.Rd

Draws the valences of one person over a plane of the configuration, as a contour map (type = "contour") with the contour of valence 0 drawn thick, or as a valence surface (type = "persp") with each object drawn at its rating, filled when the rating is above the surface and open when it is below (as in Kosugi & Fujihara, 2004). For three or more dimensions the plane passes through the centroid of the configuration.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mdspace_contour'
plot(
  x,
  person = 1,
  type = c("contour", "persp"),
  dims = c(1, 2),
  grid = NULL,
  lim = NULL,
  nlevels = 10,
  labels = TRUE,
  theta = 30,
  phi = 30,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class mdspace_contour.

person

Row number or name of the person to draw.

type

"contour" or "persp".

dims

Two dimensions spanning the plane.

grid

Number of grid points on each axis. NULL uses 101 for type = "contour" and 41 for type = "persp".

lim

Range of both axes. NULL extends the range of the configuration by 30%.

nlevels

Approximate number of contour levels.

labels

Logical; draw object labels.

theta, phi

Viewing angles for type = "persp".

...

Passed to graphics::contour() or graphics::persp().

Value

The grid (x, y, z), invisibly.
